name: Tab and Tab Group Shortcuts
description: Adds shortcuts for creating tabs, reorganizing tabs, and moving the focus.

focus-left.description: Move focus to the tab on the left, wrapping around

focus-right.description: Move focus to the tab on the right, wrapping around

focus-left-into-group.description: Move focus left into tab group

focus-right-into-group.description: Move focus right into tab group

new-tab-after-separator.description: Open new tab after the --- tab group

move-across-separator.description: Move selected tabs to the other side of the --- tab group
